title: Schedule a repeat
intro: Type a /loop command and see how Claude Code reads it.

show.title: Too frequent
show.detail: The shortest interval is one minute.

show.title: Runs on a fixed interval
show.detail: The prompt reruns at that interval while the session stays open and idle. Recurring tasks expire after a while on their own.

trace.text: Scheduled. Runs again at each interval while the session is open.

show.title: Claude sets the pace
show.detail: Without an interval, Claude picks each delay itself, between one minute and an hour. Press Esc to stop it.

fallback.title: Try a /loop command
fallback.detail: This demo only scripts /loop with an interval like 5m, without one, or with seconds.

quiz.question: Your laptop is closed. Does a /loop task still run?
options: No, it needs Claude Code open
quiz.explanation: Loops run inside your session. For work that must run while you're away, use cloud scheduled tasks.
